title: Affine change of variables for Hausdorff-measure integrals
statement: Let P, n, Q ∈ ℕ and let μ := μH[n] be Mathlib's n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P = Euclid P. For every function h : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q (no measurability or integrability assumed), every y ∈ ℝ^P and every real c > 0, the Bochner integrals satisfy ∫ h(y + c·x) dμ(x) = (c^n)⁻¹ · ∫ h dμ. In particular both sides are 0 when h is not μ-integrable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n Q : ℕ) (h : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (y : Euclid P) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → ∫ x, h (y + c • x) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)] = (c ^ n)⁻¹ • ∫ x, h x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]
